title: Robot with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1="50" y1="12" x2="50" y2="22" stroke="#7FD8E8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="4" fill="#FF6FA0"/>
  <circle cx="51" cy="9" r="1.3" fill="#FFD1E3"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x="24" y="22" width="52" height="42" rx="10" fill="#5B6E8C"/>
  <rect x="28" y="26" width="44" height="34" rx="7" fill="#3A4A66"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <rect x="18" y="34" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <rect x="76" y="34" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- eyes outline -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="42" r="9" fill="#1D2A40"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="42" r="9" fill="#1D2A40"/>
  <!-- eye glow -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="42" r="8" fill="#4FD1C5"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="42" r="8" fill="#4FD1C5"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="39" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="39" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="45" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="45" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="46" r="1" fill="#E8FFFC"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="46" r="1" fill="#E8FFFC"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M43 56 Q50 61 57 56" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x="30" y="68" width="40" height="26" rx="7" fill="#FF7A59"/>
  <rect x="34" y="72" width="32" height="18" rx="5" fill="#FF9E80"/>
  <!-- chest light -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="81" r="5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="81" r="2.5" fill="#FFF3C4"/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <rect x="20" y="70" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#FF7A59"/>
  <rect x="72" y="70" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#FF7A59"/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="90" r="4.5" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="90" r="4.5" fill="#FFB347"/>
</svg>
